name: Electro-Harmonix
author: Tone Zone
description: Pedals inspired by Electro-Harmonix gear: the Murk π fuzz family (NYC, green Russian, op-amp, bass, little, Ram's horn, nano), phasers, analog delays, polyphonic octavers, Holy Chalice reverbs, freeze / sustainers, the 9-series organ, Mellotron and synth machines, envelope filters and more – in folded-steel nano boxes, big Murk boxes and 9-series cases with big printed graphics.
